item.title: Apple Intelligence Arrives in China with iOS 27.3
item.description: Apple Intelligence launches in China via iOS 27.3 beta, powered by Alibaba’s Qwen model. Explore new AI tools, live translation, and more.

item.title: Apple Fitness+ Adds Gym Strength Plans in iOS 27.3
item.description: Apple Fitness+ adds Gym Strength, a plan that tailors reps, sets and load to your goals, equipment and schedule on iPhone, iPad and Watch.

item.title: Apple Unveils iOS 27.3 Beta, Health App Gets Redesign
item.description: Apple releases the first iOS 27.3 developer beta for iPhone, bringing back a new Health app with Health Age and Quest Diagnostics lab scheduling.

item.title: iOS 27.3 Beta Unveils All‑New Apple Health App Features
item.description: Apple’s iOS 27.3 beta brings a revamped Health app with Insights, Longevity, AI at‑home movement tests, language support, launching Dec 2026.

item.title: Apple’s Safari Gets Vertical Tabs, Dark Mode & Siri AI
item.description: Apple rolls out iOS, iPadOS, and macOS 27.3 betas, adding Safari vertical tabs, Adaptive Dark Mode, and Siri AI custom actions—changing how we browse.

item.title: iOS 27.3 Beta 1: Health App Redesign & First Look
item.description: Apple’s iOS 27.3 beta 1 lands with a revamped Health app, developer‑only rollout, and hints of upcoming public beta. We break down why it matters.

item.title: iOS 27.3 Brings Horizontal Reachability to iPhone Duo
item.description: Apple's iOS 27.3 beta adds horizontal Reachability for the wide‑screen iPhone Duo, easing one‑handed use and marking a fresh ergonomics focus.

item.title: iOS 27.3: Siri AI Gets Major App Expansion Across Apple
item.description: Explore how iOS 27.3 expands Siri AI across Music, Messages, Photos, Calendar, and more, unlocking productivity and new developer possibilities for.

item.title: Apple Opens Siri AI to Developers with App Skills
item.description: Apple’s new Siri AI ‘app skills’ let any iOS or macOS app create multi‑step voice actions, debuting in iOS 27.3 and macOS 27.3 for developers today.

item.title: iOS 27.3 Beta 1 Brings Apple Intelligence to China
item.description: Apple rolls out iOS 27.3 beta 1 with Apple Intelligence features to Chinese beta testers, marking the first AI rollout outside the US in 2026.

item.title: iOS 27.3 Beta Expands Siri AI to Four New Languages
item.description: Apple’s iOS 27.3 beta adds Siri AI support for four new languages, introduces Siri Recap, in‑app actions and developer tools, rolling out next month.

item.title: iOS 27.3 Beta Brings iPhone Duo StandBy to All iPhones
item.description: Apple's iOS 27.3 beta 1 adds new clock faces, shared-album support, and lets iPhone 11-plus users create StandBy faces, expanding Duo's smart-display.

item.title: Apple Opens Siri AI to All Apps in iOS 27.3 Preview
item.description: Apple’s iOS 27.3 Developer Preview lets Siri AI act across any third‑party app, using personal context, natural language and on‑screen awareness.
